name: Kinsman Separation Service, LLC
old_description: Service Site Visits, Start Up Services, PM Maintenance Programs, Used Equipment Sales
about:
Kinsman Separation Service, LLC operates from Stillwater, Minnesota. The company was founded by Scott Fortune, a material processing consultant with over ten years of hands-on experience in separation systems. Fortune established the business to help processing facilities improve efficiency, reduce downtime, and optimize separation equipment performance.

The firm provides nationwide consulting and field services for separation and processing equipment. Its offerings include equipment inspection, processing system audits, startup services, preventative maintenance programs, new and used equipment sales, and equipment repair. The company specializes in Forsberg separation equipment and works with a range of brands from manufacturers such as Bühler Group, Cimbria, AGI, Carter Day International, Oliver Manufacturing, Westrup, SWECO, Rotex Global, Kason Corporation, General Kinematics, Donaldson Torit, and Kice.

Kinsman serves processing facilities across the United States that rely on separation, screening, vibratory, and material handling systems. Typical customers include grain, seed, and agricultural processing plants that use equipment from the brands listed above. The company's trusted partners list reflects the equipment ecosystems it supports.

Fortune started the business to bring specialized, hands-on expertise directly to plant operators, offering a single point of contact for inspection, maintenance, and equipment procurement to keep separation lines running reliably.
